description: A multi-tenant cloud for service providers: tenants isolated on shared infrastructure, serving themselves within quotas, with their own networks and identity, metered for billing, and a way in for tenants leaving another platform.

types.tenant: Tenants with their own quotas and administrators
types.tenant_network: Virtual private networks per tenant, with their own addressing
types.tenant_identity: Tenant identity and access, separate from the provider's
types.metering: Usage metered per tenant and exported to billing
types.service_offer: Services offered to tenants beyond machines: recovery, Kubernetes, GPUs, storage
